Bebop is a Hero in Deadlock. A modified scrap golem with a big heart and a bigger extendable arm, Bebop is a potent threat on the battlefield when supported by his team. His Grappling Arm can pull friends and enemies alike towards him, saving them from certain doom or guarantee

riends and enemies alike towards him, saving them from certain doom or guaranteeing it. Bebop can attach Sticky Bombs to nearby foes and launch them in any direction with a powerful Exploding Uppercut. For any foes left standing, Bebop's Hyper Beam can cut across the battlefield and finish them off.
The mechanical son of a widowed junkyard attendant, Bebop and Ms. Shelly live together at a junkyar

of a widowed junkyard attendant, Bebop and Ms. Shelly live together at a junkyard, working with scrap metal by day and listening to jazz music by night. He can use light melees faster than other heroes (shorter recovery time), gets slowed less when using light melees, and his reload is not interrupted by light melees.
